title: Development of a near-infrared fluorescent probe for the selective detection of severe hypoxia
content:
RSC Chem. Biol., 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D4CB00243A, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Takafumi Kasai, Kyohhei Fujita, Toru Komatsu, Tasuku Ueno, Ryosuke Kojima, Kenjiro Hanaoka, Yasuteru Urano
We have developed T-azoJSiR640 as a NIR fluorescence probe for severe hypoxia. In contrast to existing NIR probes for hypoxia, the probe was able to selectively visualize severe hypoxia in live cells and in ischemic liver of a mouse model in vivo.
